verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a memory system where the AI remembers facts and preferences across conversations automatically (docs-7, docs-39), with manual add/edit/delete controls also available via Settings > Personalization > Memory (docs-30). This covers both automatic write/recall and user control, though there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of memory quality or reliability. Missing for 10: independent verification of automatic recall accuracy, details on retention limits/duration, and community confirmation the feature works well in practice.
